label: StudyAOI-spacing: does the SPACING of cloud checks matter at a fixed budget, on the Nexar metric (streaming AP and challenge mAP), and at which horizons before the event? OFFLINE ANALYSIS OF COMMITTED RESULTS; CPU only on the Orin; no GPU, no model server, no inference. Scores are continuous log P(Yes), calibrated per tier out of fold with the D105 FINAL maps; no literal Yes/No answer is used. No cloud transit latency is modelled (this isolates the value of SPACING at a fixed budget, not the cost of delay, which StudyE9d covers).

sources.fold_rule: within each label stratum, order by sha256(file_name) hex; fold = rank mod 5; pre-registered in research/EXPERIMENTS.md (StudyCTRL1b-crossfit) before any computation

device_proxy_note: A DEVICE recall answer is scored with StudyE7 Job A's committed per-question flags (the 4B on StudyRH4's D2 input). StudyD15 Part A REJECTED the H100-for-Orin proxy as an EXACT numerical stand-in, so every device recall number here is valid for ORDERING and first-order value and is NOT an exact device number. StudyE8 Part D measured 68/68 warm and 27/27 cold agreement on byte-identical inputs and StudyF4 measured 0.972-0.981 per-question agreement, which is what makes the ordering usable.
provisional_decisions: No cloud transit latency: a served instant delivers its cloud score at its own 0.5 s decision point, held forward one 0.25 s point (zero added delay). This isolates SPACING at a fixed budget; StudyE9d covers the cost of delay. PROVISIONAL.
Cloud-served fraction f is the fraction of a clip's 0.5 s DECISION instants served by the cloud; references are device-only (f=0) and always-cloud (f=1). PROVISIONAL.
Schedule randomness: 100 phase/draw seeds per family; metric and bootstrap vector averaged over seeds (StudyE9d placement convention). PROVISIONAL.

autocorrelation.note: gain_t = calibrated_cloud_logit - calibrated_device_logit at each 0.5 s decision; ACF averaged over clips with at least 14 decisions; the 1/e lag is the redundancy timescale (how long the cloud's per-instant advantage stays correlated).

negative_cloud_equals_device.description: With the cloud score set equal to the device score, spacing carries no information, so every schedule must reproduce device-only exactly.

endpoints.description: f=0 is device-only and f=1 is always-cloud by construction; all families collapse to these at the endpoints.

consistency_check.note: Single-tier AP is invariant to a monotone per-tier calibration, so always-cloud / device-only AP depends only on the raw scores. This run's cloud is the 32B JPEG body and device is the Orin 4B, while StudyE9c used the PNG H100 32B/4B trace WITH cloud latency, so these are a PLAUSIBILITY check (expected close, not identical), not an exact reproduction.
